heading.html: Ladies, Discover the Art of Korean Body Scrub Therapy

children.text: A Korean body scrub, or seshin, is a traditional exfoliation treatment performed in Korean bathhouses. Using textured mitts, the skin is vigorously scrubbed after a steam or soak to remove dead skin cells and reveal smooth, rejuvenated skin. Known for its thoroughness, this treatment improves circulation and allows for better absorption of moisturizing products. At King Spa, we offer an authentic experience that leaves your skin glowing and refreshed – the best body scrub in Virginia.

children.html:
Women's Classic Body Scrub

Experience the timeless luxury of our classic Korean body scrub. This treatment focuses on deep exfoliation, removing dead skin cells and revealing soft, smooth skin.

  • Gently removes dead skin cells for smoother skin
  • Improves overall skin texture and tone
  • Promotes relaxation and stress relief
Women's CBD Oil Body Scrub

Indulge in the calming benefits of our Women’s CBD Oil Body Scrub. Infused with soothing and premium CBD oil, this scrub treatment offers both skin and mind relaxation by reducing inflammation, deeply hydrating, and calming your senses, offering a holistic relaxation experience,

  • Reduces skin irritation with anti-inflammatory properties
  • Deeply hydrates and nourishes the skin
  • Relieves stress and promotes relaxation
Women's Gold Aroma Body Scrub

Indulge in a premium treatment with our gold-infused scrub. The luxurious combination of gold helps to revitalize and soften your skin while providing a truly opulent experience.

  • Revitalizes and softens the skin
  • Enhances skin elasticity and radiance
  • Provides a luxurious and indulgent spa experience
Women's Bubble Body Scrub

Enjoy the best of both worlds with our Women’s Bubble Body Scrub, combining a Turkish-style bath with a Korean body scrub. The bubbly foam gently exfoliates and hydrates, leaving your skin soft, smooth, and refreshed.

  • Gently exfoliates while hydrating the skin
  • Improves circulation and skin texture
  • Offers a fun, relaxing, and rejuvenating experience

heading.html: What to Expect During Your Korean Body Srub Treatment

children.cls: elementor-section elementor-inner-section elementor-element elementor-element-47be4b5 expect-num-col elementor-section-boxed elementor-section-height-default elementor-section-height-default

children.text:
• Arrive early to book your body scrub treatment in the women’s locker room. Bookings are made on-site and are first come, first served.
  • We recommend arriving 15-20 minutes before your scheduled scrub time to soak in the hot tubs, which will relax your muscles and prepare your skin for exfoliation.
  • Avoid eating a heavy meal beforehand to ensure maximum comfort during your treatment.

• Your scrub will be performed in the nude to ensure your entire body is treated from head to toe.
  • Your dedicated scrub attendant will guide you through the process, ensuring you feel comfortable and relaxed at all times.
  • As the scrub begins, you’ll see how it deeply exfoliates your skin, leaving it smooth, glowing, and refreshed.

• After your scrub, rinse off in the showers to cleanse and reveal your rejuvenated skin.
  • Make sure to moisturize afterward to lock in hydration, and be sure to stay hydrated by drinking water.
  • Continue your Korean spa experience by relaxing in our pools and saunas, or treat yourself to another indulgent service like a facial.

children.html:
Vanessa Phillips

I can't recommend this place highly enough. My mom and I live fairly far apart but wanted a chill spa weekend together. It was phenomenal to meet up at Dulles, rent a car, and come to king spa! We really enjoyed the scrubs we got (would call a must experience if it's your first time), outdoor pool, and the environment in general. We were lucky enough to come when they have the spring promotion that if you buy entry + a service, another non-weekend entry is free.
Amanda The Traveler

Amazing Korean Spa with everything you may need! My husband and I went here to get away for a little while and I couldn't be happier with my experience! We were there for 6 hours, visited all of there many Sauna's, steam, ice, and relaxing rooms. And you can not forget there hot and warm pools! And when all is said and done you must visit their restaurant for some eggs, cold noodle soup, and shaved ice with red bean (trust me you'll love it!) As Korean spas go it is a pricier option, but we'll worth it given all of the options, if you're in the area you must try!
Deanna

I went to celebrate my birthday weekend and had a relaxing time. The staff was very helpful and give you a key fob for two separate lockers, one for your shoes and the other for your clothes/personal belongings. The nude pool in the locker rooms isn't my thing but it's available to those who are okay with that. The staff is constantly cleaning, which is a plus 👌🏾; keeps the facility nice and clean. The outdoor pools upstairs were nice and warm/hot. They have several different saunas and the food was good 😊. I didn't get to stay as long as I wanted since I had to leave by a certain time to fight the traffic. I would definitely return.
Megan Durst

I've gone with my small group multiple times and with my spouse and we all thoroughly enjoy it. I usually get the body scrub because who doesn't like their skin feeling like a baby's skin? And the ice bath has become one of my favorite parts, but I've always enjoyed the variety of saunas and bade pool, and the outdoor pool(and hot tub, and bridge) is beautiful & can be relaxing too(Just maybe not on a Saturday when it's busy😅). Definitely going back.
Mykyla J

This place was AMAZING, i stepped out of many comfort zones by going here. Things are a little confusing if you are getting the body scrub service, but there were other people there who helped even if the staff couldn't. Everybody was so friendly. I will continue to keep coming back. It's a 4 hour drive from where i stay, but it is worth the drive. I will also bring other people back along with me spreading the word of this amazing place !!!
Asel Dav

The spa also includes amenities such as pools, relaxation lounges, and dining options, making it a comprehensive destination for a rejuvenating experience. children.html:
Is the Korean body scrub suitable for sensitive skin?

No, a Korean body scrub isn’t ideal for all skin types. If your skin is sensitive, you should avoid the treatment unless approved by your therapist.

What should I wear for the body scrub treatment?

The treatment is performed in the nude to ensure that your entire body is exfoliated. You’ll be provided with a towel for coverage during the treatment.

How long does the treatment take?

The Korean body scrub typically lasts about 45 minutes to an hour, depending on the treatment you choose.

Can I shower after my body scrub?

Yes, it’s recommended to rinse off after the treatment to remove exfoliated skin cells and feel refreshed. You should also moisturize afterward to keep your skin hydrated.

How often should I get a Korean body scrub?

For best results, we recommend getting a body scrub every 4-6 weeks to maintain smooth, healthy skin.

Will I experience any redness or irritation?

Mild redness may occur immediately after the scrub, but it typically fades within a few hours. If you have concerns about irritation, speak with your therapist before the treatment.

Do you wash hair during a Korean Body Scrub?

Yes, hair washing is included as part of the Korean body scrub treatment.

How do I book a Korean body scrub?

Bookings for the Korean body scrub must be made on-site and are available on a first-come, first-served basis. We recommend arriving early to secure your spot for the day.
